data.name: Trisha
data.gender_notes: Trisha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit tṛṣṇā, 'thirst, desire', from the root tṛṣ. Its root is Sanskrit tṛṣ (तृष्). A classical Sanskrit term for thirst/desire. Trisha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Thirst; desire; longing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Trisha expresses “Thirst; desire; longing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit tṛṣṇā, 'thirst, desire', from the root tṛṣ.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Trisha total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: Trisha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'tripada', which was the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology.
